metadata.description: Canonical execution order for Atlas + ChatGPT production hardening.

steps.title: Lock deployment provenance and evidence capture

instructions_json.goal: Verify the exact deployed build, production URL, and evidence recording path before new work begins.

steps.rollback_note: Pause further work if deployment provenance cannot be reconciled.

steps.title: Eliminate remaining Assistants API dependencies before the 2026-08-26 deadline

instructions_json.goal: Migrate remaining runtime dependencies to Responses-first architecture.

required_live_verification: live runtime no longer depends on Assistants API
steps.rollback_note: Revert only the migration unit if live read-back fails.

steps.title: Harden public MCP auth and privacy boundaries

instructions_json.goal: Keep OAuth enforcement, scope boundaries, and sensitivity routing correct before broader execution automation.

required_live_verification: public MCP fails closed without valid auth
steps.rollback_note: Rollback immediately if public auth or redaction safety regresses.

steps.title: Complete idempotent mutation journal and schema primitives

instructions_json.goal: Ensure canonical mutations carry provenance, verification, and rollback metadata.

required_live_verification: mutation journal fields are visible in canonical state
steps.rollback_note: Stop if canonical writes become non-idempotent.

steps.title: Complete canonical session bootstrap contract

instructions_json.goal: Fresh sessions must reconstruct durable project context and capability state.

steps.rollback_note: Rollback if fresh session context becomes incomplete or misleading.

steps.title: Upgrade Universal Ingestion to v2

instructions_json.goal: Version source events, claims, provenance, and supersession semantics.

required_live_verification: durable memories explain origin and supersession history
steps.rollback_note: Do not advance if provenance lineage becomes ambiguous.

steps.title: Finish connector gateway, schema lifecycle, state machine, and identity discovery

instructions_json.goal: Make connectors discoverable, health-aware, and identity-correct.

required_live_verification: ChatGPT/Codex can inspect capabilities without guessing
steps.rollback_note: Pause if capability discovery becomes stale or misleading.

steps.title: Modernize protocol semantics and durable orchestration

instructions_json.goal: Ensure plan-execute-verify-critic loops are protocol-aware and resumable.

required_live_verification: protocol and orchestration read-back match live behavior
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if clients become incompatible with the public MCP surface.

steps.title: Deliver cross-session and cross-device continuity

instructions_json.goal: Make work resumable with canonical checkpoints and device-aware capability continuity.

required_live_verification: new session resumes exact unfinished canonical work
steps.rollback_note: Stop if checkpoint/resume state becomes inconsistent.

steps.title: Enforce project scope and server-side approval policy

instructions_json.goal: Project boundary and approval classification must be canonical and server-side.

steps.rollback_note: Rollback if scope or approval protections weaken.

steps.title: Add command and dashboard layer on top of trustworthy health data

instructions_json.goal: Expose status, connector, resume, and system commands from canonical APIs.

required_live_verification: command layer reflects the same canonical data as execution APIs
steps.rollback_note: Do not ship commands that fabricate health or capability state.

steps.title: Harden sync, provider remediations, and Neon recovery safety

instructions_json.goal: Move event-driven sync, provider remediation, and backup/restore safety into production.

required_live_verification: recovery path is explicit and validated
steps.rollback_note: Stop if recovery assumptions are unverified.

steps.title: Expand observability and production release gates

instructions_json.goal: Status and release decisions must be evidence-backed across execution planes.

steps.rollback_note: Rollback if critical release gates can be bypassed.

steps.title: Ship Codex execution automation and machine-readable work format

instructions_json.goal: Codify execution runs, progress accounting, and evidence rules so Codex can finish work durably.

required_live_verification: Codex can report canonical step progress and resume work
steps.rollback_note: Do not advance if progress reporting is not backed by canonical state.

steps.title: Apply quality-gated performance work, then experimental routing and transcript enrichment

instructions_json.goal: Only ship optimizations or advanced routing when quality stays above the defined floor.

required_live_verification: advanced behavior never outruns measured quality
steps.rollback_note: Disable experiments immediately if they reduce correctness or traceability.
